# Pull Request

Thank you for contributing! Please fill out this template to help us review your changes effectively.

---

##  Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Be as detailed as possible.

> Example:  
> Added support for Sinhala text extraction from PDF files using Tess4J.

---

##  Related Issue(s)

Closes #[issue-number]  
Fixes #[issue-number]  
(If applicable)

---

##  Changes Made

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Code improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe below)

**Describe the changes:**

---

##  Testing

- [ ] Code builds successfully
- [ ] CLI runs as expected
- [ ] OCR output is accurate
- [ ] Clipboard copy functionality verified
- [ ] PDF and image input tested

**How did you test your changes? Describe the steps and environment:**

> Include any relevant screenshots or terminal output to demonstrate your changes.

##  Additional Notes

> Add any extra context or information here, such as known issues, limitations, or suggestions.

##  Checklist

Please check all that apply:

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
